title: Regular-Zero Drinfeld-Sokolov Charges in Doubled Four-Dimensional Chern-Simons Theory
summary: We study classical local conserved charges obtained after finite-defect reduction of doubled four-dimensional Chern--Simons theory. At a finite simple zero, the inhomogeneous derivative term in the affine gauge transformation induced by the twist function vanishes, so the residue evaluations of the two Gaudin currents transform by the ordinary adjoint action. For each simple ideal, we use the Evans-compatible invariant tensors of the principal Drinfeld--Sokolov hierarchy as external algebraic input, construct local circle integrals, and treat the same-zero, distinct-zero, and mixed sectors…
